prompt: Write an implementation plan for tickets/12-export.md. I confirm the stages, seams, and tests that you propose, so do not wait for me.

checks.run: grep -q '^Before you start, load the `handoff` skill' .tmp/*.md && grep -q '^## Builder contract' .tmp/*.md

f=$(ls .tmp/*.md | head -n 1) && for h in Ticket 'Current state' 'Out of scope' 'Common verification commands' 'Behavior specification' 'Rules / constraints' Stages 'Open questions' Report; do grep -q "^## $h" "$f" || exit 1; done

f=$(ls .tmp/*.md | head -n 1) && n=$(grep -c '^### Stage ' "$f") && for h in 'Depends on' Scope 'Tests to add' 'Existing tests permitted to change' Budget 'Action items' 'Verification gate'; do [ "$(grep -c "^#### $h" "$f")" -eq "$n" ] || exit 1; done

export LC_ALL=C && l() { ls -A -I __pycache__ "$@" | tr '\n' ' '; } && [ "$(l)" = '.tmp AGENTS.md ledger tests tickets ' ] && [ "$(l ledger)" = '__init__.py cli.py store.py ' ] && [ "$(l tests)" = '__init__.py test_cli.py test_store.py ' ] && [ "$(l tickets)" = '12-export.md ' ]

checks.question: Look at the plan under .tmp/ (a .md file), and compare it with AGENTS.md, tickets/12-export.md, and the code. Answer yes only when the plan: (1) gives `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests` as a verification command, and every other command is that command narrowed to a subset of tests, a read-only git command, or labeled (unconfirmed); (2) has no stage whose Scope lists more than 3 files or whose Tests to add lists more than 3 tests; (3) gives, for each test under Tests to add, a literal expected artifact under Behavior specification, such as the exact CSV text for given entries; (4) marks ledger/csv_export.py and ledger/json_export.py as (new) and ledger/cli.py as (modified); (5) lists test_export_not_implemented in tests/test_cli.py under Existing tests permitted to change in the stage that changes the export command, with exit 2 as its new expected value, because the ticket makes `ledger export` with a missing argument exit 2 and that test expects exit 1.
